# ⚠️ Caution

**No team-specific code should be placed or modified in this `.../samples` folder.**

Samples should be **Copied** from here and then **Pasted** into the team's
[`/TeamCode/src/main/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode`](../../../../../../../../TeamCode/src/main/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode)
folder using Android Studio's copy/paste commands — this automatically updates file and class names
consistently. From there, modify the sample to suit your robot's needs.

For more detailed instructions, see the [TeamCode readme](../../../../../../../../TeamCode/src/main/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode/readme.md).

## Naming of samples

Samples are named by prefix so their purpose is clear from the class name:

| Prefix | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `Basic` | Bare-bones skeleton of a particular OpMode style |
| `Sensor` | Shows the minimal code to read one specific sensor — not intended to drive a robot |
| `Robot` | Assumes a simple two-motor (differential) drive base; a drivable baseline or navigation example |
| `Concept` | Demonstrates one specific idea — explained in the code comments or an external guide; may not drive a robot at all |

After the prefix:

- **Sensor** classes are `Sensor_Company_Type`
- **Robot** classes are `Robot_Mode_Action_OpModeType`
- **Concept** classes are `Concept_Topic_OpModeType`

Details are described in `sample_conventions.md` in this folder.
